comments.targaryen: An implementation of the Realtime Database rules language, used by the rules suites. It is NOT Google's evaluator - see SECURITY-TEST-RESULTS.md. Pinned to a major version because the API differs between 3.x and 4.x: 3.x takes database(rules, data, now).as({uid}), and update() takes `now` as its THIRD argument while write() takes it as its FOURTH. Getting that wrong makes clock comparisons silently fail.
comments.playwright: Drives real Chrome for the browser suites. Only test/run-*.js need it; every test/security/*.js suite runs without it.
comments.no-dependencies: The site has no runtime dependencies. Firebase is loaded from the CDN by js/loader.js, exactly as before - nothing here changes how the site loads or is hosted.
